profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer @ Dentsu
profile.summary:
A Software Engineer specializing in backend development, system architecture, and DevOps, with expertise in Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, and cloud-based solutions. I have built scalable RESTful APIs, optimized databases, and deployed high-traffic applications on AWS, leveraging tools like Docker, RabbitMQ, and Redis to enhance performance and reliability. My experience includes developing microservices at Dentsu Inc. America, contributing to open-source projects such as Recoilize, and building geolocation-based applications at Hide & Secret.

🔹 Key Skills:
✅ Backend: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, Perl, GO, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ
✅ DevOps: Docker, AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, S3), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
✅ Frontend: React, Vue, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Webpack
✅ Testing & Security: Mocha, Chai, Sinon, Swagger, OAuth, JWT
✅ Cloud & CI/CD: AWS, Docker Hub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an interactive React frontend using TypeScript to create a dynamic, type-safe user interface for retrieving and placing geolocated messages, enhancing user engagement and reducing runtime errors.
• Configured Docker to containerize a React frontend, Typescript/Node.js server, Mocha/Chai test server, and MySQL database, achieving seamless development and integration using Docker Compose.
• Designed and implemented a robust continuous integration workflow using GitHub Actions, automating testing, deployment to Docker Hub, and AWS ECS upon branch pushes to ensure code quality and streamlined deployment processes.
• Established a test server environment utilizing Mocha and Chai, incorporating Sinon to mock responses by intercepting database and third-party calls, thereby avoiding direct calls and enhancing test reliability.
• Created comprehensive API documentation with Swagger and utilized Swagger UI to test endpoints during development, ensuring accurate request body values and smooth integration.
• Embedded Google Maps API while retrieving user’s geo-location to allow users retrieve or place messages in specific longitude and latitude locations while allowing users to visualize interactions with other player’s secret messages.
• Configured Knex to programmatically set up MySQL tables, enabling automatic table creation on application startup.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported 20k+ daily requests and strengthened backend reliability by architecting and optimizing RESTful APIs with Node.js/Express.js, seamlessly integrating legacy Perl systems.
• Accelerated environment setup and improved team productivity by building modular Terraform configurations to provision AWS infrastructure, including ECS clusters, S3 buckets, and RDS databases, supporting multi-environment deployments.
• Optimized deployment efficiency and enabled reliable container orchestration by implementing automated ECS pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker Hub.
• Supported 10k+ daily transactions with enhanced reliability and query efficiency by engineering high-performance, scalable MySQL databases and optimizing schema, indexes, and queries.
• Achieved reliable, low-latency processing of 20k+ messages per day by designing and implementing a RabbitMQ microservices architecture connecting Node.js and Perl services.
• Boosted system reliability and raised test coverage to 95% by implementing comprehensive unit and integration tests with Mocha, Chai, and Sinon, covering security, database mocks, and API call simulations.

positions.title: Recoilize | Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Refactored the codebase to ensure compatibility with React version 17+ by optimizing the React Fiber Tree, enabling proper rendering of Recoil’s Atoms and Selectors within the component tree for improved application performance and state management.
• Enhanced the codebase by utilizing React’s Context API for multilevel state management, removing the need for prop drilling and ensuring state is provided only to relevant components for better maintainability and performance.
• Integrated Recoil’s internal hooks within the NPM package to enable time travel functionality, capturing snapshots of state changes and allowing users to seamlessly revert to and render previous application states for enhanced user experience.
• Utilized TypeScript with React to ensure type safety across the application, improving development efficiency, reducing bugs, and enhancing code maintainability.
• Leveraged D3.js for interactive visualizations, utilizing lifecycle hooks to display graphs that illustrate the relationships between atoms, selectors, and component render times, enhancing the debugging experience by providing clear, actionable insights into application behavior.
